name: open-image-debugger
description: Gives AI agents eyes on in-memory image buffers in live gdb/lldb C/C++ debug sessions: list observable symbols at a breakpoint, view renderings, read exact pixel values, and dump lossless .npy copies. Agents can also drive the human's viewer window (pan, zoom, channels, auto-contrast).
